SELECT B.FINPROD_ID finprodId,/**金融产品代码**/ B.FINPROD_TYPE finprodType,/**拆借方向**/ B.FINPROD_TYPE finprodTypeCode,/**拆借方向Code**/ B.PRIN prin,/**名义本金**/ B.CCY ccy,/**本金币种**/ DATE_FORMAT(B.VDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as vdate,/**起息日**/ DATE_FORMAT(B.MDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as mdate,/**到期日**/ B.TERM term,/**期限(天)**/ B.TERM_TYPE termType,/**期限品种**/ B.TERM_TYPE termTypeCode,/**期限品种Code**/ B.INT_TYPE intType,/**利率类型**/ B.INT_RATE*100 intRate,/**固定利率**/ B.INT_RATE_ID intRateId,/**利率编号**/ B.BASIS basis,/**计息基础**/ B.M_PRIN_AMT mPrinAmt,/**到期本金**/ B.M_INT_AMT mIntAmt,/**到期利息**/ B.M_TRADE_AMT mTradeAmt,/**到期金额**/ C.TYPE_2 type2,/**分类2**/ C.TYPE_2 type2Code,/**分类2Code**/ B.CAPI_INCOME_FEATURE capiIncomeFeature,/**本金收益特征**/ B.CALENDAR_ID calendarId/**交易日历**/ FROM FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT B LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE C ON C.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT_ADD D ON D.FINPROD_ID=B.FINPROD_ID AND D.FINPROD_TYPE = B.FINPROD_TYPE AND B.BRANCH =D.BRANCH WHERE B.BRANCH = 0 AND B.FINPROD_TYPE in ('F08', 'F09', 'F21')
AND B.FINPROD_ID LIKE concat_ws('','%' , #{assets} , '%')
AND B.VDATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{vDateBegin},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND B.VDATE <=STR_TO_DATE(#{vDateEnd},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND B.MDATE >=STR_TO_DATE(#{mDateBegin},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND B.MDATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{mDateEnd},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND B.FINPROD_TYPE = #{directionBorrowing}
